text: Invoker win rate by rank Invoker's base win rate is 53.4% across all ranks. The skill-bracket spread shows how much the hero scales with MMR: Herald 51.6% Guardian 52.1% Crusader 52.6% Archon 53.1% Legend 53.6% Ancient 54.1% Divine 54.6% Immortal 55.1% Pro scene: 63k picks on Dotabuff, 11% ban rate in high ranks. A sharply inflated win rate reflects the current meta. Umbrella scripts for Invoker The main goal is to automate farm and focus in a fight. Umbrella scripts bind complex chains to one key, lead by target coordinates, and cast finishers the moment a kill is guaranteed. All 11 scripts are included in every plan . i Update — September 15, 2026: A new version of the script: combo slots expand to 12, a "Hold Range" slider appeared, enemy escapes are taken into account, Tornado with Eul’s Scepter was rewritten, as were the Auto-Sunstrike timings on enemy teleports. The main chains Umbrella automates: Burst combo: instant control + damage on one key via Combo Builder . Finish: auto-cast the ultimate when target HP drops below a computed threshold via Kill Stealer . Auto-farm: last-hit + deny via Last-Hit and wave block at the start via Crip Blocker . Evade: Blink, BKB or Eul on an incoming skillshot via Dodger . ★ A ready config for Invoker with binds for every script is on the CFG page. Import by code in one click via Cloud → Add By Code.
